name: Marina Garza
text: I just got cosmetic bonding here and I love my teeth! Dr Barclay took her time with me, was extremely attentive, paid attention to detail, and made me feel super comfortable! Her assistant, Ricardo, was just as important in this process! He walked me through what would happen, gave me a pillow and blanket during the procedure, and made me feel completely at ease. The office is gorgeous, the staff is so sweet, and I couldn’t recommend this place enough!

name: Jenna Stephan
text: Toothbar is the best dental experience I’ve ever had! Everyone who works there is top notch and the office is so nice! I’ve been going for over 5 years and truly look forward to going to the dentist

name: Lyndel Williams
text: I will not not use a dentist other than Dr. Jacobsen. She was my dentist and I moved from Austin for a short period of time and immediately sought her out. Her staff is very friendly, professional and make you feel very comfortable. I highly recommend her.

name: Hannah Nicholas
text: Loved everything about toothbar! I followed Brittnay Cox, my dental hygienist that I recommended to everyone, here because she is incredible… so happy I did because everything about toothbar is top notch! The environment, staff, and overall vibe is so welcoming. 10/10.

name: dave cook
text: everyone is super professional, wonderfully helpful, and very friendly and supportive🙌🏻😋

name: Morgan Shirley
text: n absolutely incredible experience! I am so impressed with their state-of-the-art screening. Between the X-rays, 3D imaging, and scans, I was able to see the full structure of my bones, the topography of my teeth, and a complete model of my mouth. The team identified my needs, recommended an amazing treatment plan, and truly prioritized patient care. Brittany went above and beyond in explaining everything, including the fascinating connection between mouth and gum health, gut health, and mental health—something no dentist has ever discussed with me in all my years of care! This wasn't just a basic cleaning; it felt like seeing a true specialist for oral health focused on preventative, diagnostic, and holistic care. I am so thankful they provided such an integrated view of my overall well-being. I don't write many reviews, so taking the time to write this truly speaks to how wonderful this practice is. I was also pleasantly surprised by the wide range of insurance plans they accept, making high-quality care accessible regardless of socio-economic status. Finding a practice that genuinely cares and takes the time to listen—rather than rushing you through like a number—is rare in healthcare, let alone dentistry. Thank you, Brittany, for such an informative session, top-notch care, and a truly whole-health approach to treatment. I beyond recommend them!

name: Jeffrey Barber
text: Very complete exam and cleaning. Professional and courtesy demonstrated. Recommend.

name: Travel TheWorld
text: I had the privilege of having Ricardo assist me today, and he made what I expected to be a stressful dental visit into a truly pleasant experience. He carefully fitted my mouth guards, explaining every step with patience. I also needed impressions made for whitening trays, and I had been dreading that process. Ricardo took his time, made sure I was comfortable, and everything went so smoothly that I had no issues at all. Even better, my custom trays were ready the very same day! Ricardo is incredibly kind, patient, and understanding. His genuine care made all the difference. If you're fortunate enough to have him as part of your dental care, you're in excellent hands. Thank you Toothbar, Dr. Bakke, and Ricardo for making a trip to the dentist such a positive experience!

name: Jacob Duncan
text: Went in for a cleaning today and the office was so nice and modern. My hygienist Lexi was amazing, very professional and concise.

name: G B
text: I had a routine cleaning and assessment at Toothbar, and it was hands-down the best experience I've had at a dentist. Lexy the hygienist was amazing—incredibly thorough but completely pain-free. On top of that, the clinic is incredibly efficient; there was absolutely no waiting around to see the doctor. Highly recommend!

name: Alicia Azpiri
text: Awesome!! Lovely and efficient staff, wonderful and super doctor!! You have a client for life!!

name: Kevin Burns
text: Toothbar is the best! The people, the space, the tech and the location.

name: Hannah McDonald
text: Dr. Bakke treats her patients with excellent care and consideration. I trust her because she always takes the time to clearly explain what kind of care she thinks is most appropriate, perfectly blending calm and professional expertise. She puts me at ease, makes me laugh, and is also incredibly patient and kind.

name: Alexander Starks
text: Came in as a new patient and enjoyed the experience. Everyone on staff was helpful and full of positive energy. Thank you to Brittany (please don’t hurt me with the needle next cleaning if I spelled the Brittany wrong) for making me feel comfortable and for the cleaning. Thank you also to Dr. Gibbons for her expertise and clear explanation on what all I needed done or should consider in order to maintain a healthy mouth and bright smile. You get two hours of free parking in the parking garage. They have a good taste in music. Everything was clean and welcoming. Thank to the ladies at Toothbar.

name: Louis Giugliano
text: Excellent dentist office. Dr. Gibbons and her staff are A+. Especially Tess!

name: Toni Barcellona
text: Can’t say enough great things about the Toothbar, Dr. Jacobson, Trey, the front desk pros and really, the whole team! I’ve been a happy patient/client since they opened their doors. Toni B.

name: Victoria Castille
text: Honestly cannot recommend enough!! I’ve always been so anxious at the dentist, which is why I’ve chosen Toothbar. Every hygienist and dentist truly cares about their patients. I recently saw Rachel and Dr. Bakke, and was very impressed how kind and thorough they were. 10/10 recommend.

name: Mario Mendez
text: I had such a great experience at Toothbar today. I went in for an emergency appointment after dealing with really bad sensitivity in my front teeth, and after not getting many answers from another dentist in East Austin, I was honestly pretty stressed. Toothbar got me in same day and immediately made me feel taken care of. Everyone was so kind and welcoming from the second I walked in. Check in was quick, the office is super nice, and they even gave me a blanket and TV while I waited which made it feel way less “dentist office” and way more relaxing. But the biggest shoutout goes to Dr. Andrea Bakke. She was AMAZING. So thorough, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. She took the time to explain everything, rule out different possibilities, and gave me more helpful information than I’ve gotten anywhere else about what could actually be causing this issue. I finally felt like someone was really listening and trying to get to the root of the problem instead of rushing me out the door. She also gave me a referral and guidance for the condition she suspects I may have, which honestly saved me a ton of time and frustration. I left feeling relieved, informed, and actually optimistic. Hands down the best dental experience I’ve ever had. Highly recommend Toothbar and Dr. Andrea Bakke. I’ll definitely be coming back and sending friends and family here too.

name: Jay Boisseau
text: Love Toothbar! The staff are friendly, professional, and thorough, and it even has a nice vibe (which I know sounds crazy for a dental office, but it’s true!).

name: Jess Movold
text: My first time here and it exceeded my expectations! My husband goes here and I kept putting off booking an appointment which lead to total Dentist Dread! I finally booked the appointment to establish care and I am soo glad I did! It was super informative, Tess and everyone there was so kind and helpful. Reset the way I view the dentist!

name: Cathy Miller
text: Best dentist I've ever used. really great. Tess and dr gibbons are awesome

name: Tom Huxtable
text: Fantastic service as always, staff are always helpful and considerate .Showed genuine compassion as i needed a quick appointment prior to an urgent Biopsy. i would thoroughly recommend this Practice

name: John McIver
text: Staff is very nice and they run on time. My teeth have been better with every visit.

name: Jonas Fischer
text: The most innovative and rewarding dental experience in Austin! Toothbar is an absolute game changer in the world of cosmetic dentistry in Austin. The concept is brilliantly executed combining professional dental care with a modern and approachable atmosphere that completely eliminates any anxiety associated with visiting the dentist. The team is highly skilled, friendly and dedicated to delivering real and visible results that genuinely transform your smile. My teeth look brighter, healthier and more beautiful than they ever have before and the treatment was comfortable, efficient and surprisingly enjoyable from start to finish. The space is stylish, immaculately clean and feels more like a luxurious wellness studio than a dental office. Toothbar is an absolute must visit for anyone in Austin who wants a smile they can truly be proud of!

name: Elizabeth Cocavessis
text: Love this dentist - the office is clean, the staff is friendly and the experience is lovely. I’ve been a patient of theirs for several years and continue to have a positive experience, complete with a healthy smile! And most importantly, the cleaning and exam are thorough! 5/5 recommend!

name: Danielle Plaso
text: It was my first visit today, and I’d absolutely recommend this place. The front desk staff were both friendly and welcoming, and I was called back quickly with hardly any wait. My dental hygienist was incredibly kind, made me feel comfortable right away, and kept things relaxed the whole time. They even offer a blanket and a neck warmer, which is such a nice touch because who wants to be cold in the dentist chair? Both the hygienist and the dentist took the time to explain anything that needed attention and clearly walked me through what to expect moving forward. It’s not easy to find a great dental office, but I’m really glad I chose this one.

name: Lisa Lisa
text: I have loved this dentist office since day ONE Everyone is so professional and kind. Highly recommend!

name: D Scans-
text: This is the best denistry in Austin! The dental hygienist are exceptional but beyond their expertise they are attractive, fun spirited and make your dental visit a big time enjoyable experience. The dentists run a crisp detail and are bright, fun and always have time for you. Try them once, i promise you won't go anywhere else plus, the office is state of the art and the location is a perfect destination for an enjoyable day in Austin-

name: AwesomeATX
text: Amazing service, location and expertise. Dr. Gibbons is truly amazing.

name: Susan Nelms
text: Great experience. Dr Baake was warm and professional and my results were better than expected. Would highly recommend if you are considering a whitening treatment!

name: Jayme Dinnerstein
text: Dr. Gibbons and Tess are the best!

name: Harrison Coley
text: What business in the new world is all about. 9/10 service, 9/10 delivery, and 9/10 pricing. Amazing systems for reminders. Admin staff - Krystal - are amazing. Knowledgeable, kind, and results oriented. Dental techs - Selinda - are friendly, focused, and show attention to detail and client care. Dentists - Dr. Gibbons - are always kind while being direct about what needs to be done and what isn’t worth worrying about. Clearly a company with a good culture. Been avoidant of dentists my whole life due to negative experiences. Here I don’t feel that way.

name: Klaudia Marino
text: As always, great job. Particularly happy with Selina today. She found a way to clean my teeth without the dreaded pain from that dang sonic water cleaner thingy. Wish I could just request her each time!

name: maryann luisi
text: Both the scheduling and service was outstanding. I highly recommend this dental office.

name: Bruce Barrett
text: Toothbar is amazing! Outstanding dentistry and a great team. Beautiful, happy office! Can’t thank Dr.Jacobson and Suzette on the team or seeing me over the New Year’s holiday and dealing with a very painful toothache! toothbar is there for you!

name: Nicolle M.
text: Nothing but positive things to say about Dr. Jacobsen and Toothbar so far- and I've been coming here for 5 years. Facilities are great- new with modern technology and always clean. They have TVs in each station with headphones so you can watch Netflix during your cleaning and procedures- it makes a difference! They also have weighted blankets and pillows so you are comfortable. The lobby also features sparkling water, cold brew on tap, and espresso pods- too bad Im never kept waiting long at this practice! They are great at sticking to appointment times. They also offer 2 hours of free parking validation which Ive never gone over during a visit. My first experience was with Invisalign. I had done 18 months of Invisalign with another dentist and was not happy with the final result. Dr.Jacobsen helped me fix my bite and smile with an additional round of retainers AND was able to get my insurance to cover the fix-it treatment! It was amazing! Cleanings are always painless, and recently had my first cavity filling here (boo) but it was incredibly painless. I also like how they had identified problem areas in prior visits but didn't drill - I was able to correct my flossing and add in a fluoride toothpaste and not have to get any fillings. Overall have been super happy coming here!

name: Clint Herzog
text: Increíble service, professional staff, and great Dentists. Best dental experience in years!!!

name: Gordon Buie
text: I will strongly recommend Toothbar to family and friends seeking dental care. The crisp contemporary interior design of the facility sets the stage for the well-coordinated and efficient teamwork of the staff. Dr. Jacobsen clearly outlined the plan for treatment and readily answered the few questions I had. Over the course of the procedure, she monitored and made adjustments to minimize any discomfort. All went exactly as outlined. All these factors, from reception to treatment to checkout, combine to result in exceptional dental care.

name: Al Leffler
text: Visiting with Dr. Barclay and her team is always a pleasure. They are so confident and understand the most current and important Dental science to maximize our care! Keep up the wonderful work!

name: anne clemons
text: Spectacular experience! Newest technology made for extreme comfort. Dr.Jacobsen and her staff are incredible. Very thankful for them.
